The Liu brothers of Yazhou were framed for rebellion by attending censor Lai Zixun; Wuzi and Lai Junchen were ordered to try the case together. Junchen accused Wuzi of favoring the prisoners and concealing evidence of rebellion; when Wuzi was later placed under Junchen's jurisdiction as well, he committed suicide.

Prefect of Yazhou Liu Xingshi and his brothers were framed for rebellion by attending censor Lai Zixun; an edict ordered Wuzi and Lai Junchen to try the case together. Junchen accused Wuzi of favoring the prisoners and concealing evidence of rebellion; when Wuzi was later placed under Junchen's jurisdiction as well, he committed suicide.
Idiomatic omits the named prefect 劉行實 (Liu Xingshi) and the office 雅州刺史 present in the Chinese.

The brothers Liu Xingshi and Liu Xingqi of Yazhou were slandered as rebels by the Attending Censor Lai Zixun; an edict ordered Wuzi and Lai Junchen to try the case jointly. Junchen said Wuzi was friendly with the prisoners and concealed their rebel evidence; later he was ordered to try Wuzi together with them, and Wuzi then killed himself.

Junchen said Wuzi was friendly with the prisoners and concealed their rebel evidence; later Junchen was ordered to try Wuzi together with them, and Wuzi then killed himself.
Literal invents a second personal name Liu Xingqi not present in 劉行實兄弟, and softens 雅州刺史.
Outwardly he seemed careful and thick, but inwardly he was harsh and mean.
Outwardly he seemed careful and generous, but inwardly he was harsh and mean.
厚 in 謹厚 means generous/kind, not physical thickness; 'thick' misrenders the character judgment.
Whenever he received orders to interrogate cases, he always washed for dirt and sought flaws; unless the accused entered death he would not stop, and people feared and despised him.
Whenever he received orders to interrogate cases, he always scrubbed for dirt and sought flaws; unless it came to a death sentence he would not stop, and people feared and despised him.
澡垢 is figurative scrubbing for faults; 不入死 means he would not stop short of a death sentence, not that the accused 'entered death'.
